title: CATL–INTILION 3 GWh TENER memorandum
specific_claims: CATL and INTILION signed a memorandum concerning 3 GWh of TENER storage systems over five years in Germany, Switzerland and Austria.
CATL says the parties have deployed more than 30 storage projects in Germany since 2022.
CATL says the parties expect to promote sodium-ion and lithium-ion routes in parallel.
supports: A named supplier and integrator publicly describe an expanded storage-system cooperation in the DACH region.
The publication is relevant to current sodium-ion market observation because its title and forward-looking discussion expressly reference sodium-ion storage.
does_not_support: That the 3 GWh TENER tranche uses sodium-ion chemistry.
A named commissioned sodium-ion stationary-storage site.
Delivery, customer acceptance, operating history or independently measured field performance.
search_boundary: One targeted official-source search group, the CATL primary page and an older INTILION contextual release; not an exhaustive market census.
x_candidate_text: CATL published an INTILION MOU for 3 GWh of TENER storage in DACH. The release does not establish a commissioned sodium-ion site or independent field data. Stop unchanged. https://structurevidence.org/cases/sodium-ion-bess/events/intilion-catl-mou-2026/
